title: Virtual Types Configuration
description: Configuration for virtual work item types that differentiate the same physical type based on criteria like area path

patternType.description: Pattern matching type: 'glob' for simple wildcard matching (**, *), 'regex' for regular expressions

areaPathCriterion.description: Criterion based on work item area path

pattern.description: Pattern to match against the area path. For glob: use ** for any path segments, * for single segment. For regex: standard regex pattern.

iterationPathCriterion.description: Criterion based on work item iteration path

pattern.description: Pattern to match against the iteration path. For glob: use ** for any path segments, * for single segment. For regex: standard regex pattern.

fieldCriterion.description: Criterion based on a custom field value

matchCriteria.description: Criteria that determine when a work item matches this virtual type

areaPath.description: Match based on area path pattern

iterationPath.description: Match based on iteration path pattern

virtualTypeDefinition.description: Definition of a virtual work item type

name.description: Unique identifier for the virtual type. Used in queries, policies, and APIs. Should be a valid identifier (letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen).

displayName.description: Human-readable name for display in reports and UI

description.description: Detailed description of what this virtual type represents

physicalType.description: The actual Azure DevOps work item type name that this virtual type is based on

criteria.description: Criteria that determine when a work item of the physical type matches this virtual type

enabled.description: Whether this virtual type definition is active

priority.description: When multiple virtual types could match, higher priority wins. Default is 0.

connections.description: Optional list of connection names where this virtual type applies. If not specified, applies to all connections.
